scenes.head: 食材的旅程
scenes.say: 一份餐點來到你手上之前，食材走過哪些路？一起來看看。
scenes.veo: Aerial-feel shot of a refrigerated delivery truck arriving at a loading area in early morning light.

scenes.head: 第 1 站：收貨驗收
scenes.say: 第一站，收貨驗收。檢查包裝、溫度，和有效日期。
scenes.veo: Staff in uniform receiving boxes from a delivery driver and checking items against a list on a clipboard.

scenes.head: 第 2 站：冷鏈入庫
scenes.say: 第二站，冷鏈入庫。冷藏保存在攝氏七度以下，冷凍保存在攝氏零下十八度以下。
scenes.veo: Close-up of a digital thermometer display on a walk-in freezer door, then the door opens revealing frosty organized shelves.

scenes.head: 第 3 站：先進先出
scenes.say: 第三站，先進先出。先到期的食材先使用，減少過期造成的浪費。
scenes.veo: Staff rotating stock on a shelf, moving older containers to the front and placing new ones at the back.

scenes.head: 第 4 站：分裝標示
scenes.say: 第四站，分裝標示。食材分成適當份量，貼上品保標籤，清楚記錄日期。
scenes.veo: Gloved hands portioning sliced chicken into containers and applying printed labels, clean steel surface.

scenes.head: 第 5 站：正確解凍
scenes.say: 第五站，解凍。食材放在冷藏庫中慢慢解凍，不在室溫下長時間放置。
scenes.veo: Time-lapse style shot of frozen fish fillets in a tray inside a refrigerator gradually thawing, soft cool light.

scenes.head: 第 6 站：生熟分開
scenes.say: 第六站，烹調。生食和熟食使用不同的砧板與器具，熟食一定確實加熱。
scenes.veo: Color-coded cutting boards on a counter, a chef using a red board for raw meat and a green board for vegetables.

scenes.head: 第 7 站：保溫出餐
scenes.say: 第七站，出餐。熱食保溫在攝氏六十度以上，冷食維持冷藏。
scenes.veo: Steam table with hot dishes in stainless pans, a server ladling food into a bento box, steam rising.

scenes.head: 終點：你的餐盤
scenes.say: 最後一站，就是你的餐盤。每一站都用心，才有這一份安心。
scenes.veo: A customer opening a fresh bento box at a table and smiling, natural window light.

scenes.head: 品富餐飲
scenes.say: 品富餐飲，從收貨到餐桌，每一步都認真把關。
scenes.veo: Slow-motion shot of fresh ingredients arranged in a circle on a wooden board, camera rotating gently above.
